name: context-viewer
description: Shows the session's context window fill above the prompt

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: full: name, tokens and percent per category; tokens: name and tokens; compact: name only; off: no legend, single-colour bar

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: round: 4.2k, 76k, 1M and whole percents; precise: one decimal everywhere (348.1k, 1.0M, 4.7%)

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Plan limit windows (5h, 7d, spend limit) and the session's spend after the context figures

hide_below_percent.title: Hide below percent
hide_below_percent.description: Keep the band hidden until the context window is at least this full (0 always shows it)

separator.title: Legend separator
separator.description: Text between header parts and legend entries; leave empty for none

show_buffer.title: Show autocompact buffer
show_buffer.description: Show the autocompact buffer as its own category in the bar and legend
